detected_fault: Frequent Crashes and Blue Screens in Games
suggested_solution: Run a thorough system diagnostic using tools like MemTest86+ and Prime95 to identify potential hardware issues.
Update the BIOS to the latest version (V1.0.0.0004) to ensure optimal performance and stability.
Monitor system temperatures using software like HWiNFO or GPU-Z to identify any thermal throttling issues.
Consider running a stress test using tools like Unigine Heaven or Valley to simulate gaming scenarios and identify potential bottlenecks.
